annotations.text:
The Decisive Moment — Instrument direction.
Near-black ground, hairline rules, IBM Plex Mono figures, one amber accent.
Top row: the Light tab in both modes. Bottom row: Map, spot detail, design system.
ANALOG. ISO is dimmed — a fact about the loaded roll, not a decision. "3 of 3" is literal: at EV 16.05 an M6 topping out at 1/1000 admits exactly three settings.
DIGITAL. Same street, same lens. ISO is at full weight and phrased as a change — "raise to 1600" — because it is the answer. 1562 exact, rounded UP to the next real step.
NO SOLUTION is a designed screen, not an empty list. HP5 400 genuinely cannot expose EV 5.0 hand-held on an M6. The shortfall is computed; each lever re-solves.
The distance scale on the analog screen is spaced linearly in 1/distance, the way a Leica barrel is engraved — which is why the marks bunch toward infinity.
